description: cartotecayfototeca.navarra.es: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartotecayfototeca.navarra.es. Coverage: the area served by cartotecayfototeca.navarra.es. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cartografía BTA 1:5.000 (año de referencia 2014). Línea de la red viar; Cartografía BTA 1:5.000 (año de referencia 2020). Línea de la red viar; Cartografía BTA 1:5.000 (año de referencia 2017). Línea de la red viar; Cartografía BTA 1:5.000 (año de referencia 2014). Recinto de la red vi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
